data.name: Aqqaad
data.gender_notes: Aqqaad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aqqaad is derived from the Arabic word ‘Aqd’, which means ‘a bond’, ‘a covenant’, or ‘a firm agreement’. In the Islamic context, it refers to a person who follows the truth and adheres to the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Quran. The name Aqqaad carries the meaning “Follower of the Truth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aqqaad usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of the truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To follow the righteous path of Allah and seek His pleasure.
data.etymology: Aqqaad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of the Truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aqqaad total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
